item.title: Huntington Beach Loses Again in Court on State Housing Law Issue

item.description: The Los Angeles Department of Water and Power agreed to inspect nearly 100 drinking water reservoirs and storage tanks, and clean more than 50 of them, after a federal agency identified maintenance issues that could pose a risk for contamination if these issues are left unaddressed, it was announced Thursday.
